question:
Find the incorrect part of the sentence:

He was senior than me in college.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the sentence lies in the use of the phrase "**senior than**." The word "senior" does not take the preposition "than."
 
• Instead, the correct preposition to use after "senior" is "**to**."
